name: AgentSentinel
description: Persistent monitoring for XDC price, gas and wallet balances. Create a watch, then check it for every change since the last check, including moves between checks.

routes.capability: xdc.price.snapshot: current XDC/USD price and XDC gas price with 1h and 24h high, low and percent change from 15 second sampling; GET, no request body

xdc.monitor.watch.create: persistent watch, monitor and alert on XDC/USD price, XDC gas price or XDC wallet balance with threshold triggers (above, below, crosses, percent change); returns watch_token and current value
xdc.monitor.watch.check: report per watch since its last check: current price, gas or balance value, triggered flag, every alert trigger between checks with time and value, high, low, sample count
xdc.monitor.info: free description of watch types, conditions, route costs and example request bodies
xdc.monitor.watches.status: free configuration and lifecycle status of watches by watch_token
xdc.monitor.events.history: free history of triggers already reported by check
xdc.monitor.watch.cancel: free cancellation of watches by watch_token
